question: Can reasoning and external actions share a single resident unmodified instruction backbone and two genuinely recurrent final-layer views, preserve every previously correct field and public task and improve on untouched Base across quality, time and memory?
protocol: Independent primary from the exact 24 original instruction-sibling layers. No hidden target, state or learned correction from the closed folded-backbone, report-calculation or preference fits. Share one frozen eight-bit instruction prefix and original BF16 final layer. The qualified typed adapter and an independently trained reasoning adapter each apply the same final layer twice with distinct native caches. No block is removed. Fit the reasoning adapter on 1536 SmolTalk MetaMathQA worked solutions, 768 balanced human BoolQ training passages, and 256 HotpotQA training questions with complete ten-document context. Some reasoning prompts include optional real schemas, including the calculator. Train a separate width-64 request gate on question and catalog embeddings with class-balanced optimization. Positive examples come from logged SGD operations or clarifications, typed calls and 167 independent read-oriented APIGen requests. Negative examples have a worked text answer, with APIs available. Group the 424 held-out validation rows by normalized question. At inference score only a request and its caller-visible catalog; below .20 external probability select reasoning, otherwise the frozen tool view. Both views may freely call every supplied API. Without available tools use reasoning, delegating original eligible multi-line evidence prompts and long requests to the qualified parent. Stop after one cold, sequential direct pair of counterbalanced task families. The 120 requests use 24 new ASDiv/SVAMP human problems, 24 new balanced BoolQ questions and all 50 archived field tasks plus 22 public executable requests. Both arms get identical opening IDs, actual providers, thinking enabled, a 384-token cap per turn and three turns. Measure cold model loading, all gate decisions and switching plus total requests, first tokens, peak MLX bytes, real observations, all native cache site histories, and the parameter memory physically shared by both views. The native throughput/material trials at 131K are separate; long-context deployability of a passing combined system still requires real isolation and replay.
gate: Require at least 12 net additional mixed successes, exact item-level and shared-resource cluster randomization p<=.05 and at least four net new successes on the 48 fresh human questions. Both new human families must gain at least one. Correct completions, visible final-answer accuracy and completion counts must equal or exceed Base separately on every enrolled family. At least 12 more grounded successes overall. Retain every previously correct response in all 50 cold field and all 22 public calls. Summed first-token time, total wall time and peak allocation across the cold stream must all be strictly lower than Base. Both router classes at least 85% correct on held-out question groups, at least 98% of the smaller view’s weights physically shared, both cache checks exact in top decision with distinct layer-23 states and max logit error <=.6. Any miss closes this fit. A pass licenses an equal-exposure one-application reasoning adapter before attributing the gain to depth and an offline combined full-length and independent field retention study before promotion.
